integrity: All references identify prior work and all numerical checks are disclosed as supporting rather than infinite proofs. No independent mathematical review or priority certification is claimed.
scientific_limitations: Exact independent Pareto renewal resets and fresh scaled Brownian paths, 0<beta<2 and 1<alpha<2; excludes aging diffusivity after reset, non-Pareto clocks, rate bounds and alpha<=1. Classical renewal-reward stable-limit lemmas are invoked, not originated here.
title: Two thresholds and a Cauchy law for signed exposure under Pareto resetting
